justification: Both panels include human figures with detailed attire, but A depicts a horizontal narrative procession with a horse-drawn chariot and rows of standing dignitaries, while B depicts a single, densely layered vertical figure covered in symbolic regalia with no chariot, animal, or multi-figure procession. The compositional logic (horizontal registers vs. single vertical stele), the specific motifs (chariot, wheel, battlement-like crenellations, repeated rosette border) and the relationships between figures are entirely different, so beyond the generic presence of clothed human figures there is little specific iconographic overlap.
